title: Fake Homework Helper
scenario: A Discord post offers free answers for tomorrow’s test if you enter your school account.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Fake Homework Helper: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Study tools should not ask for your school password through chat links.
